title: OpenAI Launches Dedicated Robotics Hardware Division
summary: On May 31, 2026, Sam Altman announced on X that OpenAI's world-simulation research effort had evolved into 'OpenAI Robotics,' a new internal division tasked with programming and manufacturing general-purpose robots, and that the group was hiring across 11 specialized full-stack hardware, ops, systems and ML roles in San Francisco. Co-founder Greg Brockman said the group was making rapid progress on physical-world AI. The near-term focus is robots that support construction of data centers, power grids and factories; Altman's stated long-term goal is everyone having a personal robot doing anything they need. The division evolved out of OpenAI's world-simulation research program and marks the company's first dedicated robotics team since it shut down its original robotics group, the Dactyl hand project, in 2021.
whyItMatters: OpenAI re-entering robotics as a builder rather than an investor is a significant strategic pivot for one of the most influential AI labs, and reshapes the competitive landscape for humanoid and embodied-AI companies it previously backed, including 1X Technologies and, briefly, Figure AI.
